scope: Preserve newer chat-default edits through delayed or failed saves, retain each brand’s committed defaults and restore keyboard focus after removing criteria.

regression.result: Ten regression tests failed while 66 tests passed across three files. Reproductions included draft replacement, stale success, duplicate writes, cross-brand lost updates, late old-brand errors and lost focus after removal.

type_correction.result: Initial verification stopped at three new test queries using an unsupported Testing Library option. Those queries were corrected; no pass is claimed for that attempt.

implementation: Serialize defaults writes and merge each snapshot with the latest committed brands when its turn starts. Failed or rejected acknowledgements preserve the committed map and allow the next write/retry.
Keep edits in the form when preferences are acknowledged. Load stored defaults on workspace entry and initial storage recovery.

Bind success/error feedback to the submitted draft and scope, prevent duplicate submissions, and ignore stale completions after navigation. Show progress and unsaved changes without replacing the draft.
Keep save failures inline with a retry message. Return focus to Add criterion after removing a check, including when the eight-check limit had disabled that button.

verification.checks: Root/E2E types, lint, Electron/renderer builds, unit regressions and four native flows without retries.
verification.native_method: Two theme flows gate/fail preference writes only in owned temporary profiles. Successful writes delegate to the actual production IPC storage handler; both retry and survive process restart. Two existing criteria flows check layout, accessibility and keyboard focus after removal.

source_guard.qualification: Manual hashes sealed after lint/format preparation and compared after checks; not an immutable queue snapshot.

verification.full_validation: Pending exact-head CI after normal-hook commit and push; parent CI does not qualify this change.

limitations: Storage delays/failures are deliberately injected test conditions; the real main-process handler normally returns true or throws. The false-ack test is a compatibility boundary check, not an observed native disk error.
No live engine/Temporal/sandbox/NSR acceptance. A designated CHAT_TEST workspace is still required.
No version/tag/release or update publication; v1.1.19 unchanged.
